thread:
Marta Chen: Need to get an offer out today for Kai (adjunct data engineer). Based in Germany, asked for local pay. Band lookup shows S3 but adjunct caps normally S2. Manager proposing USD 105,000 annualized pro‑rated for 6 months + $3,000 sign-on. Also proposing split onboarding: 2 weeks remote then onsite.
Sam Patel: @Marta for geo differential >10% vs cap we need finance sign-off. Adjunct exception policy allows short contracts with written market rationale. Can you paste a short rationale and confirm exact start dates?
Marta Chen: Rationale: rare infra + model-serving experience, immediate ramp for latency/cost work, low conversion probability in 6mo. Start remote 2026-04-20, onsite 2026-05-04. I added the note to the offer doc.
Priya Nair: Quick heads up on payroll: if engaged in DE through a local payroll/EoR, we must present gross EUR equivalent. Who will handle payroll ops? Also adjuncts are not benefits-eligible until conversion — flag that in the letter.
Lars Becker: Please include cost_center and budget_owner. Any PO? Exceptions over band cap need director approval. Ping @offers-bot so we have a ticket to track.
Marta Chen: cost_center: ENG-ML-101, budget_owner: Marta Chen, PO: n/a (contractor). Hiring lead confirmed no planned conversion during the contract window. Can we route approvals to finance + legal?
offers-bot: Approval request created: APP-8921. Routing path: people-ops -> finance -> legal. https://redwood.in/offers/APP-8921
Sam Patel: I'll open the comp-exception form. Marta please paste a concise market premium line into APP-8921 (helps approvals).
Marta Chen: Pasted this to the ticket: "Specialized MLOps/serving expertise; immediate production impact on latency and unit cost; market rates 12% above S2 cap; 6mo fixed-term." 
offers-bot: APP-8921 routed to Finance (Lars) at 1780012360.
Lars Becker: Provisional approval: confirmed total USD 52,500 for 6 months + $3,000 sign-on. Approve pending confirmation of contractor tax classification from People Ops. :thumbsup:
Priya Nair: Legal raised a contractor/employee risk note — recommend the standard clause: "If conversion occurs within 3 months of start, benefits and tax treatment will be reviewed and any necessary adjustments documented." Objections?
Marta Chen: No objections, add the clause.
Sam Patel: I'll add the addendum, update APP-8921, and prepare the offer letter. ETA: today EOD if legal signs off. Who should send the offer email?
Marta Chen: People Ops please send so it's centralized.
Sam Patel: Will do. Offer email will include split-start schedule, DE payroll note, and adjunct benefits exception. I'll attach the gross EUR equivalent once payroll confirms.
Marta Chen: Thanks all :pray:
offers-bot: APP-8921 closed: Offer cleared to send at 1780012408."
